description: This PHP source file defines the SavePerformanceTrackerController class within the OrangeHRM project, responsible for managing the save or edit view of performance trackers in the HRM system. It extends an abstract controller and sets up components based on request attributes.

classes.name: SavePerformanceTrackerController
classes.description: Controller handling the saving and editing of performance tracker data, rendering different Vue components based on request parameters.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component to be rendered, choosing between edit and save components based on whether an 'id' attribute exists in the request.
